lines.beaver: 민지야, 졸업하고 뭐 해? 진학은 어떻게 해?
lines.beaver_en: Minji, what are you doing after graduating? What about further study?
lines.beaver_roman: minjiya, joreopago mwo hae? jinhageun eotteoke hae?
lines.en: I decided to go on to grad school.

lines.learner: 응, 장학금을 받았어. 받을 줄 몰랐어.
lines.en: Yeah, I got a scholarship. I didn't expect it.
lines.roman: eung, janghakgeumeul badasseo. badeul jul mollasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Amazing! Who told you to go to grad school?
lines.en: My professor suggested we do research together.

lines.beaver_en: So you'll start right after graduating?
lines.learner: 응, 쉬지 않고 바로 다닐 거야.
lines.en: Yeah, I'll start right away without a break.
lines.roman: eung, swiji anko baro danil geoya.

lines.en: My mom asked what kind of study that is.

lines.beaver_en: Haha. You start right after graduating.
lines.en: Yeah, the entrance ceremony is the week after graduation.

lines.beaver_en: What will you do in grad school?
lines.en: A senior told me to try being a TA.

lines.beaver_en: A TA? Then you'll be busy from the morning.
lines.en: Yeah, I have to get things ready for first period.
lines.roman: eung, ilgyosi sueop junbimureul chaenggyeoya hae.

lines.en: Handouts and a laptop. My bag gets full.

lines.beaver_en: Cool. Let's grab a meal sometimes after graduation.
lines.en: Sure. I'll keep in touch even in grad school!
